japanese: すみません、タクシー乗り場はどこですか？
reading: すみません、たくしーのりばはどこですか？
romaji: sumimasen, takushii noriba wa doko desu ka?
english: Excuse me, where is the taxi stand?
literalMeaning: Excuse me, where is the taxi boarding area?
naturalUsage: Natural at stations, airports, and hotels.

japanese: タクシーをお願いします。
reading: たくしーをおねがいします。
literalMeaning: A taxi, please.
naturalUsage: Useful at a hotel, restaurant, or front desk when asking staff to call one.

japanese: ここまでお願いします。
reading: ここまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as here.
naturalUsage: Very natural while showing the driver a map, address, or phone screen.

japanese: この住所までお願いします。
reading: このじゅうしょまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to this address.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as this address.
naturalUsage: Use while showing a written address.

japanese: 〇〇駅までお願いします。
reading: 〇〇えきまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as ___ Station.
naturalUsage: One of the most natural ways to state a taxi destination.

japanese: 〇〇ホテルまでお願いします。
reading: 〇〇ほてるまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as ___ Hotel.
naturalUsage: Natural and concise when heading to your hotel.

japanese: この地図を見てもらえますか？
reading: このちずをみてもらえますか？
romaji: kono chizu o mite moraemasu ka?
english: Could you look at this map?
literalMeaning: Could I have you look at this map?
naturalUsage: Useful if pronunciation of the destination is difficult.

japanese: ここで大丈夫です。
reading: ここでだいじょうぶです。
literalMeaning: Here is okay.
naturalUsage: Very natural when you want to get out at the current spot.

japanese: ここで降ります。
reading: ここでおります。
literalMeaning: I will get off here.
naturalUsage: Natural when the taxi has reached a suitable stopping point.

japanese: 少し待ってもらえますか？
reading: すこしまってもらえますか？
literalMeaning: Could I have you wait a little?
naturalUsage: Useful for a brief stop or while someone joins the taxi.

japanese: 急いでいます。
reading: いそいでいます。
literalMeaning: I am in a hurry.
naturalUsage: Useful context, but it does not ask the driver to break traffic rules.

japanese: 時間はどのくらいかかりますか？
reading: じかんはどのくらいかかりますか？
romaji: jikan wa dono kurai kakarimasu ka?
english: About how long will it take?
literalMeaning: About how much time will it take?
naturalUsage: Natural way to ask for approximate travel time.

japanese: 料金はどのくらいですか？
reading: りょうきんはどのくらいですか？
romaji: ryoukin wa dono kurai desu ka?
english: About how much will it cost?
literalMeaning: About how much is the fare?
naturalUsage: Useful before a longer ride.

japanese: カードは使えますか？
reading: かーどはつかえますか？
literalMeaning: Can a card be used?
naturalUsage: Very useful before or at the end of the ride.

japanese: 現金で払います。
reading: げんきんではらいます。
literalMeaning: I will pay in cash.
naturalUsage: Natural when choosing cash at the end of the trip.

japanese: レシートをお願いします。
reading: れしーとをおねがいします。
literalMeaning: A receipt, please.
naturalUsage: Useful if you need a taxi receipt.

japanese: 荷物があります。
reading: にもつがあります。
literalMeaning: There is luggage.
naturalUsage: Useful before getting in if you have suitcases that need the trunk.

japanese: ありがとうございます。
reading: ありがとうございます。
literalMeaning: Thank you very much.
naturalUsage: Natural at the end of the ride.

japanese: 成田空港までお願いします。
reading: なりたくうこうまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as Narita Airport.
naturalUsage: A natural destination phrase; replace the airport as needed.

japanese: 羽田空港までお願いします。
reading: はねだくうこうまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as Haneda Airport.
naturalUsage: Useful in Tokyo.

japanese: このホテルまでお願いします。
reading: このほてるまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to this hotel.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as this hotel.
naturalUsage: Use while showing the hotel name or booking screen.

japanese: このお店までお願いします。
reading: このおみせまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to this shop/restaurant.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as this shop.
naturalUsage: Useful while showing a destination on your phone.

japanese: この場所までお願いします。
reading: このばしょまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to this place.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as this place.
naturalUsage: General-purpose destination phrase while pointing to a map.

japanese: このピンの場所までお願いします。
reading: このぴんのばしょまでおねがいします。
romaji: kono pin no basho made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to this pinned location.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the location of this pin.
naturalUsage: Very practical when showing Google/Apple Maps.

japanese: 入口の前までお願いします。
reading: いりぐちのまえまでおねがいします。
romaji: iriguchi no mae made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to the entrance.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as in front of the entrance.
naturalUsage: Useful at large hotels, malls, venues, or hospitals.

japanese: 正面玄関までお願いします。
reading: しょうめんげんかんまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to the main entrance.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the front entrance.
naturalUsage: Natural for hotels and larger buildings.

japanese: 駅の東口までお願いします。
reading: えきのひがしぐちまでおねがいします。
romaji: eki no higashi-guchi made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to the station's East Exit.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the station's East Exit.
naturalUsage: Useful at large stations with multiple taxi drop-off areas.

japanese: 駅の西口までお願いします。
reading: えきのにしぐちまでおねがいします。
romaji: eki no nishi-guchi made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to the station's West Exit.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the station's West Exit.
naturalUsage: Useful at major stations.

japanese: 駅の近くまでお願いします。
reading: えきのちかくまでおねがいします。
romaji: eki no chikaku made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me near the station.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as near the station.
naturalUsage: Useful if the exact station entrance is congested.

japanese: この交差点までお願いします。
reading: このこうさてんまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to this intersection.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as this intersection.
naturalUsage: Useful when the destination is easiest to identify by an intersection.

japanese: この建物の前までお願いします。
reading: このたてもののまえまでおねがいします。
romaji: kono tatemono no mae made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me in front of this building.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as in front of this building.
naturalUsage: Use while showing a photo or map.

japanese: 一番近いコンビニまでお願いします。
reading: いちばんちかいこんびにまでおねがいします。
romaji: ichiban chikai konbini made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to the nearest convenience store.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the nearest convenience store.
naturalUsage: Useful when you simply need the nearest convenience store.

japanese: 一番近い病院までお願いします。
reading: いちばんちかいびょういんまでおねがいします。
romaji: ichiban chikai byouin made onegai shimasu.
english: Please take me to the nearest hospital.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the nearest hospital.
naturalUsage: Useful in a medical situation when you can safely travel by taxi.

japanese: 最寄り駅までお願いします。
reading: もよりえきまでおねがいします。
english: Please take me to the nearest station.
literalMeaning: Please go as far as the nearest station.
naturalUsage: Very useful if you are somewhere unfamiliar.

japanese: 〇〇の近くまでお願いします。
reading: 〇〇のちかくまでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please go as far as near ___.
naturalUsage: Useful if stopping directly in front is difficult.

japanese: 住所を見せますね。
reading: じゅうしょをみせますね。
literalMeaning: I'll show the address.
naturalUsage: Natural conversational lead-in before showing your phone.

japanese: まっすぐお願いします。
reading: まっすぐおねがいします。
literalMeaning: Straight, please.
naturalUsage: Short and natural if guiding the driver locally.

japanese: 次を右にお願いします。
reading: つぎをみぎにおねがいします。
romaji: tsugi o migi ni onegai shimasu.
english: Please turn right at the next one.
literalMeaning: At the next one, right please.
naturalUsage: Natural when giving simple turn-by-turn guidance.

japanese: 次を左にお願いします。
reading: つぎをひだりにおねがいします。
romaji: tsugi o hidari ni onegai shimasu.
english: Please turn left at the next one.
literalMeaning: At the next one, left please.
naturalUsage: Natural when guiding the driver.

japanese: 次の信号を右にお願いします。
reading: つぎのしんごうをみぎにおねがいします。
romaji: tsugi no shingou o migi ni onegai shimasu.
english: Please turn right at the next traffic light.
literalMeaning: At the next signal, right please.
naturalUsage: Clear and practical direction.

japanese: 次の信号を左にお願いします。
reading: つぎのしんごうをひだりにおねがいします。
romaji: tsugi no shingou o hidari ni onegai shimasu.
english: Please turn left at the next traffic light.
literalMeaning: At the next signal, left please.
naturalUsage: Clear and practical direction.

japanese: この道をまっすぐです。
reading: このみちをまっすぐです。
literalMeaning: Straight along this road.
naturalUsage: Useful if the driver asks you to confirm the route.

japanese: この角を右です。
reading: このかどをみぎです。
literalMeaning: At this corner, right.
naturalUsage: A concise spoken direction.

japanese: この角を左です。
reading: このかどをひだりです。
literalMeaning: At this corner, left.
naturalUsage: A concise spoken direction.

japanese: もう少し先です。
reading: もうすこしさきです。
literalMeaning: It is a little farther ahead.
naturalUsage: Very natural when approaching the destination.

japanese: もう少し戻ってください。
reading: もうすこしもどってください。
literalMeaning: Please return a little.
naturalUsage: Useful if you passed the destination and it is safe/legal to go back.

japanese: 反対側です。
reading: はんたいがわです。
literalMeaning: It is on the opposite side.
naturalUsage: Useful when pointing out the destination across the street.

japanese: 右側です。
reading: みぎがわです。
literalMeaning: It is on the right side.
naturalUsage: Useful as you approach your destination.

japanese: 左側です。
reading: ひだりがわです。
literalMeaning: It is on the left side.
naturalUsage: Useful as you approach your destination.

japanese: あの建物です。
reading: あのたてものです。
literalMeaning: It is that building.
naturalUsage: Very natural while pointing out the destination.

japanese: あのコンビニの隣です。
reading: あのこんびにのとなりです。
english: It's next to that convenience store.
literalMeaning: It is next to that convenience store.
naturalUsage: Useful landmark-based guidance.

japanese: ナビの通りで大丈夫です。
reading: なびのとおりでだいじょうぶです。
romaji: nabi no toori de daijoubu desu.
literalMeaning: The navigation route is okay.
naturalUsage: Natural if the driver asks whether their navigation route is okay.

japanese: 高速道路を使っても大丈夫です。
reading: こうそくどうろをつかってもだいじょうぶです。
romaji: kousoku douro o tsukatte mo daijoubu desu.
english: It's okay to take the expressway.
literalMeaning: It is okay to use the expressway.
naturalUsage: Useful for longer rides when toll roads may be faster.

japanese: 高速道路は使わなくて大丈夫です。
reading: こうそくどうろはつかわなくてだいじょうぶです。
romaji: kousoku douro wa tsukawanakute daijoubu desu.
english: No need to take the expressway.
literalMeaning: It is okay not to use the expressway.
naturalUsage: Useful if you prefer to avoid toll roads.

japanese: だいたいいくらかかりますか？
reading: だいたいいくらかかりますか？
english: About how much will it cost?
literalMeaning: Approximately how much will it cost?
naturalUsage: Natural way to ask for a rough fare estimate.

japanese: メーターでお願いします。
reading: めーたーでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: By the meter, please.
naturalUsage: Useful where you need to confirm a metered fare; in Japan regular taxis normally use meters.

japanese: 高速料金は別ですか？
reading: こうそくりょうきんはべつですか？
romaji: kousoku ryoukin wa betsu desu ka?
literalMeaning: Is the expressway fee separate?
naturalUsage: Useful before taking a toll road.

japanese: 追加料金はありますか？
reading: ついかりょうきんはありますか？
literalMeaning: Are there additional fees?
naturalUsage: Useful for late-night, toll, or booking-related charges.

japanese: 深夜料金はかかりますか？
reading: しんやりょうきんはかかりますか？
literalMeaning: Does a late-night fee apply?
naturalUsage: Useful when taking a taxi late at night.

japanese: 迎車料金はかかりますか？
reading: げいしゃりょうきんはかかりますか？
literalMeaning: Does a vehicle-dispatch fee apply?
naturalUsage: Useful for taxis called through an app, hotel, or dispatch service.

japanese: 料金を確認してもいいですか？
reading: りょうきんをかくにんしてもいいですか？
romaji: ryoukin o kakunin shite mo ii desu ka?
literalMeaning: Is it okay if I check the fare?
naturalUsage: Useful if you want to look at the meter before paying.

japanese: カードで払えますか？
reading: かーどではらえますか？
literalMeaning: Can I pay by card?
naturalUsage: Natural and concise.

japanese: クレジットカードでお願いします。
reading: くれじっとかーどでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: By credit card, please.
naturalUsage: Use when choosing the payment method.

japanese: ICカードは使えますか？
reading: あいしーかーどはつかえますか？
english: Can I pay with an IC card?
literalMeaning: Can an IC card be used?
naturalUsage: Some taxis accept transport IC cards such as Suica/PASMO/ICOCA.

japanese: タッチ決済は使えますか？
reading: たっちけっさいはつかえますか？
literalMeaning: Can touch payment be used?
naturalUsage: Useful for contactless bank cards where supported.

japanese: 現金でお願いします。
reading: げんきんでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: By cash, please.
naturalUsage: Use when choosing cash.

japanese: 一万円札でも大丈夫ですか？
reading: いちまんえんさつでもだいじょうぶですか？
romaji: ichiman-en satsu demo daijoubu desu ka?
literalMeaning: Is it okay even with a 10,000-yen note?
naturalUsage: Useful if you only have a large bill.

japanese: お釣りはありますか？
reading: おつりはありますか？
literalMeaning: Is there change?
naturalUsage: Useful if paying with a large note.

japanese: 領収書をお願いします。
reading: りょうしゅうしょをおねがいします。
literalMeaning: An official receipt, please.
naturalUsage: Useful for reimbursement or business records.

japanese: レシートをお願いします。
reading: れしーとをおねがいします。
literalMeaning: A receipt, please.
naturalUsage: Simple request after payment.

japanese: この料金で合っていますか？
reading: このりょうきんであっていますか？
literalMeaning: Is this fare correct?
naturalUsage: Use politely if you genuinely need clarification about the amount.

japanese: アプリで支払い済みです。
reading: あぷりでしはらいずみです。
english: I've already paid through the app.
literalMeaning: Payment has already been completed in the app.
naturalUsage: Useful with app-booked taxis where payment was handled digitally.

japanese: ここで止めてください。
reading: ここでとめてください。
literalMeaning: Please stop here.
naturalUsage: Direct but polite; useful when the driver can safely stop.

japanese: ここで大丈夫です。
reading: ここでだいじょうぶです。
literalMeaning: Here is okay.
naturalUsage: Softer and extremely natural when indicating a drop-off point.

japanese: この先で止めてください。
reading: このさきでとめてください。
english: Please stop a little farther ahead.
literalMeaning: Please stop ahead of here.
naturalUsage: Useful as you approach the destination.

japanese: 次の角で止めてください。
reading: つぎのかどでとめてください。
romaji: tsugi no kado de tomete kudasai.
english: Please stop at the next corner.
literalMeaning: Please stop at the next corner.
naturalUsage: Natural if there is a safe stopping place there.

japanese: 信号の手前でお願いします。
reading: しんごうのてまえでおねがいします。
romaji: shingou no temae de onegai shimasu.
english: Please stop before the traffic light.
literalMeaning: Before the traffic light, please.
naturalUsage: Useful when identifying a convenient drop-off point.

japanese: 入口の前でお願いします。
reading: いりぐちのまえでおねがいします。
romaji: iriguchi no mae de onegai shimasu.
english: In front of the entrance, please.
literalMeaning: In front of the entrance, please.
naturalUsage: Natural for hotel, mall, venue, or hospital drop-offs.

japanese: コンビニの前でお願いします。
reading: こんびにのまえでおねがいします。
romaji: konbini no mae de onegai shimasu.
english: In front of the convenience store, please.
literalMeaning: In front of the convenience store, please.
naturalUsage: Useful when the convenience store is an obvious landmark.

japanese: あの建物の前でお願いします。
reading: あのたてもののまえでおねがいします。
romaji: ano tatemono no mae de onegai shimasu.
english: In front of that building, please.
literalMeaning: In front of that building, please.
naturalUsage: Natural while pointing.

japanese: 少し先でお願いします。
reading: すこしさきでおねがいします。
literalMeaning: A little ahead, please.
naturalUsage: Very natural near your destination.

japanese: もう少し先までお願いします。
reading: もうすこしさきまでおねがいします。
romaji: mou sukoshi saki made onegai shimasu.
literalMeaning: Please go a little farther ahead.
naturalUsage: Useful if the driver starts to stop slightly too early.

japanese: ここで少し待ってもらえますか？
reading: ここですこしまってもらえますか？
romaji: koko de sukoshi matte moraemasu ka?
english: Could you wait here for a moment?
literalMeaning: Could I have you wait here a little?
naturalUsage: Useful for a brief pickup or errand; waiting charges may apply.

japanese: 五分くらい待ってもらえますか？
reading: ごふんくらいまってもらえますか？
english: Could you wait about five minutes?
literalMeaning: Could I have you wait about five minutes?
naturalUsage: Useful for a short stop; expect the meter to continue.

japanese: ここで友達を乗せます。
reading: ここでともだちをのせます。
english: I'm picking up a friend here.
literalMeaning: I will have a friend get in here.
naturalUsage: Useful if making a brief stop to pick someone up.

japanese: 途中で一か所寄れますか？
reading: とちゅうでいっかしょよれますか？
english: Can we make one stop on the way?
literalMeaning: Can we stop at one place along the way?
naturalUsage: Natural way to ask for an intermediate stop.

japanese: 途中でコンビニに寄れますか？
reading: とちゅうでこんびにによれますか？
romaji: tochuu de konbini ni yoremasu ka?
english: Can we stop at a convenience store on the way?
literalMeaning: Can we stop by a convenience store along the way?
naturalUsage: Useful on longer rides.

japanese: 先にこの場所に寄ってください。
reading: さきにこのばしょによってください。
romaji: saki ni kono basho ni yotte kudasai.
english: Please stop at this place first.
literalMeaning: Please stop by this place first.
naturalUsage: Use while showing the first stop on your phone.

japanese: そのあとホテルまでお願いします。
reading: そのあとほてるまでおねがいします。
romaji: sono ato hoteru made onegai shimasu.
english: After that, please take me to the hotel.
literalMeaning: After that, please go as far as the hotel.
naturalUsage: Useful when explaining a two-stop taxi trip.

japanese: ここで降ろしてください。
reading: ここでおろしてください。
literalMeaning: Please let me get out here.
naturalUsage: Natural, clear request when you want to get out at the current location.
